headline: Mexico GDP Expands 0.9% in Q3, Slowing From Previous Quarter
summary: Mexico's gross domestic product grew 0.9% in the third quarter of 2026, moderating from 1.4% in the second quarter, while advancing 3.3% on an annual basis supported by services and retail.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy, and its cyclical growth trajectories drive monetary policy choices by Banxico.
